name: Sprint 3 candidate — iteration 04
description: Exploratory attrition-weakness pass. Bruiser breakthrough forces expose lighter staying power and no universal Guard screen; selected Nightwalker infantry survive ordinary 3-Attack retaliation. Not yet the live default.

bruiser_vanguard.rulesText: A forward screen with the Presence to occupy ground; vulnerable to precision fire.

bruiser_ambush.rulesText: Response: deal 2 damage to the attacker before combat.

nightwalker_ambush.rulesText: Response: deal 4 damage to the attacker before combat.

nightwalker_strike.rulesText: Deal 5 damage to one enemy battlefield card.

rogue_commander.rulesText: Unique. Command — other allies here gain +1 Attack. Mobile. Medic — heal each ally here by 1 at your turn start.
